lines.trans: Hello! I have a problem with the trolley here.
Unfortunately, my key won't come out of there anymore.
Ask for Wilhelm, I think that happens pretty often.
He knows his way around that well.
I don't really know right now what I should do with it.
It would be a pity about the key.
Thanks, that is very sweet of you!
Gladly! I'll quickly grab a trolley token for you too.
Thank you very much!
